resource.title: Grok Bot × Aqua Voice：检索语音转写并管理词典、替换与偏好

resource.verification_note_en: README, manifests and license were read; no account connected. The repo contains client config, not hosted backend source. History depends on privacy settings, and OAuth may request read and write scopes together.

resource.author: Josh Hudson
resource.summary_zh: MIT 工具把 Bot 的角色、Skill、记忆与 Routine 描述导入 Hermes，并做双向同步、冲突检测和写前恢复点；可选 g2h 让两个自有 Bot 互发消息，外部文本按不可信数据封装。

resource.verification_note_en: README, tree and security entry points were read; not run. This is an early v0.1 with one maintainer; live import and 10/10 exchanges are author tests. The bridge is not a security boundary and bundles contain personal data.
